lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web(1) to end plate(3) ~90 deg rounded fold. Sections at 25/50/75% show the line exactly on the outer-skin apex (outer skin -0.02..+0.02 mm along bisector, centred laterally). Apex points occupy t=-0.5..56.8 of a 56.9 mm line with no gaps; it runs relief to relief between the corner notches.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web to +y side flange(5), ~90 deg. The fold is clean on all three sections and the line sits on the outer apex (-0.01/+0.01/-0.02 mm). Apex support runs t=-0.6..121.2 of 121.4 mm, from the chamfered far end to the corner relief, with no gaps.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web to -y side flange(6), ~90 deg. The line is on the outer apex (-0.04/0.00/+0.01 mm). Coverage runs t=-0.2..121.6 of 121.6 mm, the full fold from end to corner relief.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: End plate(3) to +y side flange(5), ~90 deg. The line is on the outer apex (-0.02/-0.01/0.00 mm). The close-up shows it running from the corner relief to the relief notch where the end-plate flange stops (~46 mm in close-up coordinates). The only near-line points past the end are sparse thickness-edge points of the end plate beyond the notch, not fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: End plate to -y side flange(6), ~90 deg; mirror of B4. The line is on the outer apex (-0.02/-0.01/+0.01 mm) and runs the full flange from the corner relief to the relief notch.
